name: Victorian
description: Cream paper, a double gilt rule, and a burgundy action.
bestFor: Formal pages that should feel printed and ornamented.
promptFragment: Visual style: Victorian. Use a dark wood ground, cream panels, a double gilt border, burgundy for actions, and a classical serif. Corners are nearly square. Ornament stays in the frame, not in the words. Avoid neon, pixel edges, and casual handwritten type. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
